payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, specifically through a multimodal approach.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by using a hybrid LSTM-CNN architecture that processes both modalities for named entity recognition.
The proposed multimodal NER system effectively combines visual information with textual data to enhance recognition performance.
The modality attention module in the NER model selectively integrates information from both text and images to improve context extraction.
